channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Wilbur Ross says pied-à-terre tax targets those who can't retaliate at ballot box
item.description: The former commerce secretary and Steve Wynn are suing the state over annual bills of $83,531 and $183,094 on their Manhattan homes.

item.title: Cloudflare launches tool to charge AI agents in stablecoins
item.description: Using USDC, the feature operates as a pay-as-you-go system for AI agents browsing the web.

item.title: AI becomes Hollywood's newest star, changing work on and off camera
item.description: Higgsfield AI, Runway, and Luma are among the startups using AI to reshape Hollywood's production process.

item.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley and Jamie Dimon launch $2 billion initiative
item.description: A report on America's skilled trades says employers will need to fill about 1.7 million openings annually through 2035.
